driver: The decisive quantity is how much a set of units can deliver in a forward period, and each unit's deliverable positions are fewer than the positions it reports because some of them cannot be worked at the same time, a ceiling no file states and no attestation reflects; the ceiling is fixed exactly by the greatest number of the unit's own timed service intervals that have ever run together, repeated in every period of a long record, so multiplying reported positions by staffed sessions overstates the total and overstates it most at the units whose ceiling is lowest.
driver_concrete: The plan's 2027 contracted outpatient capacity in weekly treatment slots comes from each site's deliverable positions times its rostered sessions; a third of the sites have never, in four years of timed encounters, run more than a fixed number of treatments at once, several short of the stations the directory attests and the licence lists, because those sites share a water loop, a compounding hood or a nurse ratio across the extra chairs, and taking the attested or licensed stations overstates the network by about a sixth and puts three areas above the utilisation standard that are below it.

lineage.layer2_pattern: own:concordance by distribution matching, not regression
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many units fall below a cut on a new instrument's scale when part of the population was measured only on the old instrument; a sample measured on both links the scales, and predicting each unit's new value by regression shrinks every converted value toward the sample's mean, so the converted spread is too narrow and the tail beyond the cut too thin, while matching the percentiles of two groups each measured on one instrument assumes the groups are alike; only a conversion that matches the two instruments' distributions in the sample measured on both keeps the share beyond the cut.
